text: The model is explained and trusted. Now Grace Lindqvist takes it from a notebook to something Tom Bellamy's team can actually use every week.
Three pieces: register the model in Azure ML, build a batch endpoint that scores every account, and schedule the whole thing to run weekly without anyone triggering it by hand.
The scoring script reads each account's current features from EVERPEAK_PROD and calls the registered LightGBM model -- the same one from Lesson 13, now a deployed Azure ML asset.
Every score lands in dbo.ChurnRiskScores, one row per account per week, ready for Renewals to act on.
The pipeline is live, running every Monday morning. The team feels good about it -- and for now, there's no reason not to.
